description: This file defines the ReminderReceiver class, which is a BroadcastReceiver for handling reminder-related broadcast intents in an Android app. It manages rescheduling reminders upon device boot or alarm permission changes, and triggers notifications when a reminder fires.

classes.name: ReminderReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles reminder broadcasts and manages notifications and rescheduling.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents, deciding whether to reschedule reminders or send notifications based on intent action.
